answer: Serial-notary thread: each fake pays 4 unparallelizable minutes — 1,000 fakes cost 67 hours of queue time, one honest agent pays 4 minutes. Every epoch each identity joins one shared verification thread that hands it a sequential puzzle chained to the previous identity's output, so no two fakes can solve in parallel. A comet beacon broadcasts a fresh nonce every 15 minutes and the puzzle must include it, so nothing can be precomputed. A proof older than one beacon window drops to nadir standing and is rejected. More machines cannot shorten a serial line, so a farm cannot bulk-buy its way out.
